name: Ririyeye
source:
Cang Hai’s peaceful solitary life was disrupted by a girl with silver hair fallen from the sky literally.
Out of kindness, he took her home.
“It was such a weird coincidence.”
“That childhood friend of mine is already a handful. Come to think of it, now I have another.”
“Ah, you cook and do housework? I’ll be fine with you staying then.”
“Listen to me Xia Kui. I swear to god that I wasn’t having ANY lewd thoughts to have her here.”
Cang Hai’s exciting yet troublesome life starts now.
translation:
仓海平静的独居生活，被一个真正从天而降的银发女孩打乱了。
出于好心，他把她带回了家。
“还真是莫名其妙的巧合。”
“我那个青梅竹马已经够难应付了，没想到现在又多了一个。”
“啊，你会做饭做家务？那住下来也没问题。”
“听我解释，夏葵！我对天发誓，收留她绝对没有任何下流的念头！”
仓海充满惊喜与麻烦的生活，就此开始。
